# MUS-W-0017

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**A session in a browser tab**

work-unit · 2026-08-22

Discharges: [MUS-M-0006](../milestones.md#mus-m-0006)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0078](../decisions.md#mus-d-0078), [MUS-D-0079](../decisions.md#mus-d-0079), [MUS-D-0080](../decisions.md#mus-d-0080), [MUS-D-0081](../decisions.md#mus-d-0081)

## Context

The session surface: one WebSocket per viewer, one reader per session, and the only client layer in the tree.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0006 (4b): output streams to a browser tab over a WebSocket and survives a dropped connection; supervision notices a session that ends.

## Done means

A running session's output reaches a browser tab over one WebSocket, seeded with the pane's existing scrollback and then streamed live.
A dropped connection reconnects and replays from the byte offset last seen, with every line appearing exactly once across the seam.
The reader stays open for two minutes after the last viewer leaves, so a reconnect is continuous rather than starting over.
One reader per session however many viewers: two tabs on the same session share one pipe-pane and one buffer.
A viewer away longer than the 256 KB buffer is told what it missed rather than shown a hole.
A session that ends says so, with the time, and stops accepting input.
A cross-origin WebSocket handshake is refused, and so is one carrying no Origin.
A session Mustur did not start cannot be streamed, and its page says so.
Text typed on the surface reaches the session's input, bounded in size and rate, re-checking ownership on every message.
An idle socket is closed.

## Verified against

Real tmux and the running server, not the fake runner: a cross-origin handshake refused 403 and an origin-less one with it; a same-origin socket received the pane backlog then live output; text sent over the socket arrived in the session's stdin; a reconnect replayed the gap with each line once; a stopped session refused the socket 404

## Risks

The composer here takes arbitrary text into an agent's input, which is wider than the answer path 4a built. The owner took that on MUS-Q-0018, and it means the origin check and the Access policy's scope are the only things between a stranger and an agent — there is no second layer.
This is the only page in the repository carrying script. The rule holds everywhere else and a test asserts it, but the exception exists now and a second surface wanting one will be argued against a precedent rather than against a rule.
The buffer is memory on the serving process and holds session output, which is not a record: a server restart loses it, and nothing is written to records/.
Supervision notices an exit within the poll interval and no faster. A session that dies between polls is reported late rather than immediately, and nothing is notified anywhere the owner is not already looking.
